tenders.title: Machine Learning Engineer
tenders.scope_summary: Seeking a Machine Learning Engineer to design, develop, deploy, and operationalize ML and AI solutions within a banking environment. The role focuses on building scalable, secure, and production-ready ML solutions to support business decision-making, automation, risk management, customer insights, and digital innovation.
key_points: Design, build, test, deploy, and maintain machine learning models and AI-driven solutions.
Support design, development, deployment, and operationalization of machine learning and AI solutions.
Focus on scalable, secure, and production-ready ML solutions.
Support business decision-making, automation, risk management, customer insights, and digital innovation.

Technical skills include Python (essential), SQL, Scala, R, Java, or C++, Machine Learning / AI Feature Engineering, Model Deployment, Model Monitoring, MLOps, Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch, Pandas, NumPy, MLflow, Docker / Kubernetes, Git / CI/CD, REST APIs, Spark / PySpark / Databricks, AWS / Azure / GCP.
